base.alt: Concept image: a bright, empty family room with a vaulted ceiling, dated walls and a bare floor, before any design work.

baseVariants.prompt: A realistic photograph of an EMPTY family room in an ordinary 1990s to 2010s Midwest American suburban house, not a loft and not luxury. Bright, open and airy: big windows, lots of soft daylight, light floors. A tall vaulted ceiling. Plain thin builder baseboards, no crown moulding, no wall panelling. Eye-level camera standing in a corner. One large, plain, completely clear main wall is fully visible and unobstructed. Nothing hangs on the walls. No people, no plants, no text, no logos. Natural colour, gentle shadows, 4:3 photograph. The walls are painted a tired, dated khaki olive, a flat greenish beige that looks a little drab.

editInstruction: Keep EVERYTHING that already exists exactly as it is: the same camera position, lens, framing, walls, wall colour, trim, window, floor, light and furniture. Keep the lighting and exposure identical: do not darken, re-light or add shadows to the walls, floor or ceiling beyond a soft contact shadow directly under the new item. Do not crop, zoom, re-light or restyle. Only make this change:

stages.caption: First the bones: wide, plain trim around the windows and taller baseboards, the kind a farmhouse room is built on.
A washed vintage rug and a deep sectional that the whole family can pile onto.
A sturdy wood table for feet and board games, a console for the TV, and a lantern to light the middle of the room.
A leather chair that gets softer every year.
A big photograph on the wall and a tree in the corner, so the room has something to look at.
Then the easy layers: plaid pillows, a dough bowl, a few dried stems.

final.alt: Concept image: the finished family room in a modern farmhouse style, with a sectional, a reclaimed wood table, a leather chair, a lantern and styling.
